ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   D. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
